articles.title: RECURRING PAYMENTS ARE CORE GROWTH LEVERS
articles.summary:
Revenue on repeat is the lifeblood of any SaaS or AI company - but today, that means dealing with rising fraud risk, margin compression, increasing failed payment rates, and shifting consumer expectations.

In this on-demand session [5], Plaid joins special guest from Forrester, Lily Varon, to share insights from 2025 Q4 research on the broader payments landscape [6], with a specific focus on billing and recurring payments trends. Watch to learn:

* Where the billing and recurring payments landscape is headed * How your recurring payments strategy stacks up against industry benchmarks * Practical approaches to reducing failed transactions and improving payment performance

articles.title: INFLUENCE DOESN'T COME WITH THE PROMOTION
articles.summary: Influence comes from trust, not titles or winning arguments. The strongest leaders listen, stay persuadable, and build credibility that carries beyond the room.

articles.title: TECHNICAL INGREDIENTS, REVENUE INGREDIENTS
articles.summary: Faster AI coding does not automatically mean faster revenue. As software becomes easier to build, commercial readiness and go-to-market become the real bottlenecks.

articles.title: TURN BUGS INTO FEATURES
articles.summary: Product weaknesses do not always need to be fixed. With the right positioning, constraints and perceived flaws can become differentiators that make a product more compelling to the right customers.

articles.title: THE ART OF SIMPLIFYING DECISIONS
articles.summary: As AI accelerates execution, decision-making becomes the bottleneck. Strong teams match the decision process to the stakes instead of treating every choice like it requires consensus.

articles.title: HOW TO BUILD A HIGH-GROWTH OPERATING SYSTEM
articles.summary: High-growth companies win through speed, focus, talent, and continuous learning. The best sustain that pace by embracing change, managing organizational debt, and staying connected to customer impact.

articles.title: HOW A SOLO FOUNDER USED CODEX AND CHATGPT TO LAUNCH A FASHION BRAND WITHOUT ENGINEERS (33 MINUTE VIDEO)
articles.summary: AI is letting solo founders operate specialized tools and build across disciplines without traditional teams. The result is a dramatic expansion of what one person can create and launch.

articles.title: WHO WILL BE THE BASTION OF AMERICAN OPEN-WEIGHT AI LEADERSHIP?
articles.summary: The US leads frontier AI but risks losing the open-weight ecosystem to China. NVIDIA, Meta, and other platform companies have strong incentives to keep American open models competitive.

articles.title: WHY AI MAKES EXPERTS MORE VALUABLE
articles.summary: AI makes specialized work more accessible, but expertise still compounds. The people with the best judgment may gain the most leverage from AI.
